about.title: About
paragraphs: I bring together two things that rarely go together in advertising: numbers and craft.

In the morning I work in payroll and billing at a clinic. It is a routine of double-checking, deadlines, spreadsheets and responsibility over figures that cannot be wrong. That is where I learned discipline with data — and that is exactly the discipline media management demands.

The rest of my time is advertising. I study Advertising at UNASP, after a semester in Radio & TV, where I learned what much of the media team cannot do: script, shoot, host and edit a video end to end.

cards.title: “Eis o Cordeiro” musical
cards.body: I wrote the script, played a character and handled costume, set and music selection.

cards.title: Xerente Mission 2025
cards.body: 15 days of volunteer service in a Xerente indigenous community.

about.closing: Both taught me the same thing: communication only works when you speak to the audience that exists, not the one you imagined.
